tasks.label: WP8.1: Build Debug ARM
args: $msbuild=(Get-Command MSBuild.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if(-not $msbuild){throw 'MSBuild.exe not found. Install Visual Studio with WP8.1 tools.'};& $msbuild '${workspaceFolder}\ESP32-AI-Control-WP81.sln' /m /t:Build /p:Configuration=Debug /p:Platform=ARM /verbosity:minimal;if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
